work_tmp="${TMPDIR}/spu_verify_$$"

  'https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/PharmacyRankingALL.html'; do
  name=\""'$(basename "$url")"

    printf '"'%s ' \""'$name"
    rg -io -n '"'.{0,160}sardar.{0,240}' \""'$work_tmp/$name" | head -3 || true

done

find \""'$work_tmp" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '"'%f %s bytes\\n' | sort"

    The Sardar Patel Ayurvedic Medical College & Hospital, under Sardar Patel University (SPU), is devoted to preserving and promoting the ancient science of Ayurveda through modern education, clinical practice, and research. The institution upholds the rich heritage of traditional Indian medicine while integrating contemporary medical approaches to meet present-day healthcare challenges.

    Offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Ayurveda, the College provides a balanced blend of classical Ayurvedic wisdom and scientific innovation. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical and practical learning through extensive clinical exposure, research projects, and community health initiatives.

    The attached Ayurvedic Hospital serves as a teaching and training center, equipped with specialized departments, herbal gardens, and modern diagnostic facilities. Students gain valuable experience in patient care, Panchakarma therapies, and evidence-based Ayurvedic practices under the guidance of experienced faculty and practitioners.

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import sys
s=BeautifulSoup(open(sys.argv[1],errors='ignore').read(),'html.parser')
for table in s.find_all('table'):
 rows=[]
 for tr in table.find_all('tr'):
  cells=[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in tr.find_all(['th','td'])]
  if cells: rows.append(cells)
 if rows and rows[0][:2]==['S.No.','Course']:
  parent=table
  trail=[]
  for _ in range(7):
   if not parent: break
   trail.append(parent.name+':'+parent.get('class',[]).__str__())
   parent=parent.parent
  print('TABLE')
  print('trail',trail)
  print('prev headings:')
  for x in table.find_all_previous(['h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6','div'],limit=15):
   txt=x.get_text(' ',strip=True)
   if txt and len(txt)<100: print(repr(txt),x.name,x.get('class'))
  print(rows)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc 'site_tmp="$(dirname "$(find "${TMPDIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '"'19_brochures.html' -print -quit)\")\"
python3 - \""'$site_tmp" <<'"'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from collections import Counter
root=Path(__import__('sys').argv[1])
files=['4_school-of-engineering-technology.html','5_school-of-agriculture-science-technology-research.html','6_school-of-pharmaceutical-science-research.html','7_institute-of-pharmaceutical-science-research.html','9_sardar-patel-college-of-pharmacy.html','10_sardar-patel-college-of-nursing.html','11_school-of-paramedical-education.html','12_school-of-education.html','14_school-of-commerce-and-management.html','15_school-of-science-computer-application.html','16_school-of-legal-studies-research.html','17_school-of-arts-social-science.html']
rows=[]
for f in files:
 s=BeautifulSoup((root/f).read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 for table in s.find_all('table'):
  trs=table.find_all('tr')
  if not trs: continue
  hs=[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in trs[0].find_all(['th','td'])]
  if not hs or hs[0]"'!='"'S.No.': continue
  mode='regular'
  prev=' '.join(x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in table.find_all_previous(['div'],limit=3))
  # robust nearest nav tab title
  for x in table.find_all_previous('div'):
   t=x.get_text(' ',strip=True)
   if t in ('Course (Regular)','Course (Part Time)'):
    mode='part-time' if t=='Course (Part Time)' else 'regular'; break
  for tr in trs[1:]:
   cells=[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in tr.find_all(['th','td'])]
   if len(cells)==len(hs): rows.append((f,mode,*cells[1:]))
print('all table rows',len(rows))
key=lambda r:(r[1],r[2],r[3],r[4])
c=Counter(key(r) for r in rows)
print('unique rows',len(c),'duplicates:')
for k,n in c.items():

# quick count via generated file logic simplified
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
root=Path(__import__('sys').argv[1]); files=[p for p in root.glob('*.html') if p.name.split('_',1)[0].isdigit() and 4<=int(p.name.split('_',1)[0])<=17 and int(p.name.split('_',1)[0]) not in (8,13)]
rows=[]
for p in files:
 s=BeautifulSoup(p.read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 for t in s.find_all('table'):
  trs=t.find_all('tr'); h=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in trs[0].find_all(['th','td'])] if trs else []
  if h and h[0]=='S.No.' and 'Course' in h:
   mode='part-time' if any(x.get_text(' ',strip=True)=='Course (Part Time)' for x in t.find_all_previous('div')) else 'regular'
   for tr in trs[1:]:
    c=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in tr.find_all(['th','td'])]
    if len(c)==len(h): rows.append((c[1],c[2],mode,c[-2],c[-1]))
print(len(rows),len(set(rows)))
PY"
